articles.summary: Western Products, a Douglas Dynamics brand, recently celebrated 75 years of U.S.-based manufacturing and innovation at its Milwaukee facility. This milestone honors WESTERN’s legacy of innovation, quality, and service, a tradition that has helped shape the snow and ice control equipment industry since 1950. Nearly 500 employees, retirees, families, dealers, and suppliers joined the celebration. [...]Read More... from WESTERN® Marks 75 Years of Manufacturing Excellence in Milwaukee!
articles.title: WESTERN® Marks 75 Years of Manufacturing Excellence in Milwaukee!
